name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response aligns with the prompt's context and specific requirements.

name: Clarity
description: Assesses the clarity and comprehensibility of the response, including grammar and structure.

name: Completeness
description: Evaluates whether the response addresses all aspects of the prompt and provides sufficient information.

name: Engagement
description: Measures the level of engagement or interaction within the conversation, particularly in dialogue-based prompts.

name: Technical Accuracy
description: Assesses the correctness of technical information provided, especially in responses involving specific knowledge (e.g., coding, sports science).

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in more open-ended prompts.

name: Conciseness
description: Measures how succinctly the response conveys its message without unnecessary verbosity.

name: Empathy
description: Assesses the degree to which the response acknowledges and addresses the user's feelings or needs, especially in conversational contexts.
